title: Top-down pixel acid: tiny algorithms for liquids that eat the world
description: Graphical research study on efficient old-school acid for top-down pixel art: liquids, material corrosion, equipment and flesh, slimes, time.

description: Playable 320x180 acid dungeon: spreading acid, corroding items, slimes, fumes, rust, x-ray buffers.

title: Top-down pixel rain: tiny algorithms for drizzle, downpours and everything that gets wet
description: Graphical research study on efficient old-school rain for top-down pixel art: tiers, wind, ripples, wetness by material, puddles, drips, storms, mist.

title: Rain Sandbox (playable)
description: Playable 320x180 rainy courtyard: drizzle to storm, puddles, ripples, drips, fire, lightning, umbrella, x-ray buffers.

title: Top-down pixel forests: tiny algorithms for thousands of living trees
description: Graphical research study on top-down pixel forests: biomes, species, seasons, interaction, birds, performance.

title: Forest Sandbox (playable)
description: Playable procedural forest world: 7 forest types, seasons, wind, occlusion modes, shade, birds, culling grid, sprite atlas.

title: Top-down pixel light and shadow: tiny algorithms for sun, fire, lanterns and the dark
description: Graphical research study on 2D/top-down pixel lighting: sun, artificial and carried light, personality, object interaction, performance.

title: Light Sandbox (playable)
description: Playable lighting village: day/night, sun shadows, polar shadow maps, enterable house, carried lights, colormap mode.
